# Support

## How to Get Help

If you need help with the Cisco AI Defense Python SDK, here are some resources:

### Documentation

- **README**: Start with the [project README](https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/ai-defense-python-sdk#readme) for installation, quickstart, and usage examples.
- **Examples**: Browse the [examples/](https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/ai-defense-python-sdk/tree/main/examples) directory for end-to-end integration samples across frameworks and cloud runtimes.
- **Agent Runtime Configuration**: See `examples/agentsec/CONFIGURATION.md` for `agentsec.yaml` configuration reference.

### Reporting Bugs

If you've found a bug, please [open an issue](https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/ai-defense-python-sdk/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) using the bug report template. Include as much detail as possible: SDK version, Python version, OS, error output, and steps to reproduce.

### Requesting Features

Have an idea for a new feature? [Open a feature request](https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/ai-defense-python-sdk/issues/new?template=feature_request.md) and describe the use case.

### Security Issues

**Do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities.** Please use [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/ai-defense-python-sdk/security/advisories/new) or email [oss-security@cisco.com](mailto:oss-security@cisco.com). See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for full details.

### Community

- Check existing [issues](https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/ai-defense-python-sdk/issues) and [discussions](https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/ai-defense-python-sdk/discussions) to see if your question has already been answered.
- For general questions about Cisco AI Defense, visit [cisco.com](https://www.cisco.com/).
